title: Company of Ash: Grimdark Skirmish Warfare
intro: Command elite military units in a war-torn fantasy realm where steel, tactics, and cunning determine victory. Engage in intense squad-based combat with dynamic terrain, destructible environments, and devastating special abilities.

features.title: Tactical Squad Combat
features.description: Lead your Company through intense skirmish battles using positioning, cover mechanics, and coordinated squad maneuvers. Every decision matters as you adapt to the ever-changing battlefield.

features.title: Army Builder Tools
features.description: Customize your forces with the interactive Army Builder. Select units, equip them with devastating weapons, and balance your force composition to counter your opponent's strategy.

features.title: Advanced Combat Calculator
features.description: Resolve complex combat interactions with our integrated Combat Calculator. Factor in range, cover, facing, and unit capabilities to determine outcomes with precision and speed.

features.title: Expandable Universe
features.description: From elite infantry to heavily armored walkers, the Company of Ash universe continues to grow with new unit types, weapons, and special rules to keep the game fresh and engaging.
